automount.description: Whether to automatically mount removable media (e.g., USB sticks, SD cards) when inserted.

automount_internal_drives.description: Whether to automatically mount internal drives (e.g., internal SATA/PCIe SSDs/HDDs) — use with caution.

user.description: User account to own auto-mounted volumes. Often set to a regular user for desktop systems.

mount_options.description: List of mount options to apply by default to auto-mounted filesystems.

minimum_uid.description: Minimum allowed UID for auto-mounted volumes (prevents accidental root ownership conflicts).

maximum_uid.description: Maximum allowed UID for auto-mounted volumes (must be ≥ minimum_uid).

ignore_encrypted.description: If true, skip auto-mounting of encrypted devices (e.g., LUKS). Manual unlocking is required.

auto_unmount_timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before auto-unmounting a device. Set to 0 to disable auto-unmount.

polling_enabled.description: Enable polling (instead of relying solely on udev events) for removable media insertion/removal.

filesystems_to_mount.description: Explicit list of filesystem types to auto-mount. If empty, use the built-in default (typically ext*, vfat, ntfs, exfat, iso9660, etc.).

filesystems_to_ignore.description: List of filesystem types to *never* auto-mount — e.g., swap partitions or ZFS pools.

ntfs_mount_readonly.description: Mount NTFS volumes as read-only by default if ntfs-3g (full NTFS write support) is not available.

enable_lvm2.description: Enable udisks2 support for LVM2 logical volumes (requires lvm2 tools on system).

enable_mdraid.description: Enable udisks2 support for MD RAID arrays (requires mdadm tools on system).

state_dir.description: Directory for runtime state (e.g., device cache, lock files). Should be a tmpfs location for speed.

log_dir.description: Directory for log files generated by udisks2.
